en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), within the Triplet on the Wholesome (Kusalattika)
Conditioned by a non-visible, non-reactive, unwholesome state, a wholesome state that is non-visible and non-reactive arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a non-visible, non-reactive, unwholesome state, a wholesome state that is non-visible and non-reactive arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by both a non-visible, non-reactive, unwholesome state and a non-visible, non-reactive [state]...
Conditioned by a wholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a wholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and is unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, with resistance, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is visible, with resistance, and indeterminate by way of root condition … seven. (Abbreviated.
[The roots of the non-visible-with-resistance-indeterminate are exactly seven; the roots of the dyads are exactly seven; all are twenty-one. Under root condition there are twenty-one;
under predominance condition there are twenty-one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
